summary: 本轮严格检索了 arXiv、公开项目页、实验室与公司研究页面、GitHub 以及相关研究信息后，没有发现自上次成功运行以来真正新增且足够相关的灵巧机器人手或灵巧操作条目。今日可见的近邻候选要么属于通用双臂/人形遥操作范畴、未把灵巧手作为核心贡献，要么虽与本主题相关但发布时间早于上一轮成功运行，因此不作为本次新增项纳入。
summary_en: After a strict pass over arXiv, public project pages, lab and company research pages, GitHub, and related research sources, I did not find any genuinely new item since the last successful run that met the bar for dexterous robot hands or dexterous manipulation. The nearby candidates visible today were either general bimanual or humanoid teleoperation work that did not center dexterous hands, or they were relevant but first public before the previous successful run, so they are not added in this report.
caveats: 本轮沿用已有 seen-items 状态做增量去重。
8 月 5 日窗口里可见的部分近邻候选与本主题相关性不足或早于上一轮成功运行，因此未纳入。
